releases.notes:
## Changelog

- **PacketTools forensics:** Added item and inventory forensic capture with inventory, container, equipment, dropped-item, item-component, and packet activity records. Added session summaries, snapshots, packet timing, transaction correlation, and BookBot diagnostics. Full item content can be included in exports.
- **BookBot:** Replaced the earlier phase-lock approach with server update timing estimates and adaptive shelf-transfer timing. Added inventory planning, confirmation checks, shelf validation, and safeguards for occupied cursors or books that move before transfer.
- **NoGoZone:** Improved zone management and persistence across servers. Zones are loaded for the active server, saved as they change, and enforced against movement packets as well as normal player motion.
- **ServerIntel and UI-Utils:** Added ServerIntel and expanded the scanning interface with command and plugin scans, server fingerprints, scan history, legacy scanning, and DupeDB updates and lookups.
- **AutoEat:** Prevents repeated use actions while eating, respects items the player is already using and manual attacks, and restores the selected slot safely. Clears its pause state after reaching the configured hunger target.
- **AutoFly:** Old/new chunk stop checks now scan behind the player as well as ahead, so passing a chunk doesn’t immediately skip detection.
- **NewChunks:** Added palette-based chunk classification alongside fluid signals, improved handling of ignored or changing chunk data, and made scanning single-threaded to reduce overhead.
- **NoWeb:** Added SpeedHack support that subdivides movement through cobwebs without lowering speed. It checks intermediate collisions and reports when PacketFirewall or protocol support prevents subdivision.
- **MobOwners and ItemHandler:** Added optional chat alerts for named entities and entities with known owners, including coordinates. MobOwners also reports nearby named mobs and owned entities.
- **AltGUI:** Added category grouping and support for additional setting editors, including player-mute lists, sound lists, and hack-list controls.
- **Movement and combat fixes:** MultiAura now pauses cleanly for AutoEat and resets its attack timer on resume. Fixed SafeWalk’s ledge-setting name and improved movement packet compatibility in DuraSwap, FastBreak, and SpeedNuker.
- **Singleplayer and interaction fixes:** Prevented NoSlowdown from changing mob behavior, Jesus from affecting mobs, and HandNoClip from changing which blocks Endermen can pick up. Fixed NoWeather side effects and allowed AirPlace to pass through entity interactions such as mounting Happy Ghasts.
- **Mixin and compatibility cleanup:** Moved several feature hooks into feature-specific mixins, removed obsolete compatibility and resource-pack warning code, and updated the Gradle wrapper, Spotless, Fabric API, and Sodium dependencies. Fixed issue found late in release relating to upstream merge (HandNoClip & AntiKnockback + Others)
- **Improved 32 hacks** by reducing idle work and adding dimension & equipment checks. 
- **Release:** Updated the fork version to **0.62**.

## 1.21.11 Updated!
- Major feature backport: Brought 1.21.11 substantially closer to master (26.3), including upstream Wurst updates to v7.56.1, while adapting APIs for 1.21.11.
- Patreon integration: Added supporter registration, entitlement verification, promotional startup screen and supporter settings.
- Compatibility and stability: Numerous 1.21.11-specific fixes, mixin corrections, regression tests, GameTest fixes, build updates and improved version compatibility.

releases.notes:
## New Hacks

- **AntiFov** - Removes potion effect movement modifiers when calculating player FOV.
- **PearlLauncher** - Sends a position packet burst before vanilla uses an ender pearl, adding a configurable movement delta to its launch velocity. Includes an optional range estimate and low-health warning.
- **Telemetrics** - Reports server position changes while excluding login positioning and corrections that match recently sent movement.
- **Triangulator** - Collects locator-bar bearings as you move along a baseline, then fits the observations to estimate a target’s position.
- **VillagerDupe** - Automates villager shearing interactions. Added the `.villagerdupe` command with run, wait, preset, stop, and status modes.

## Updated Hacks and Features

- **NewerNewChunks** - Queues chunk coordinates from packets and processes them when full chunks are available. Rescans use loaded chunks; fluid scans read chunk sections directly, and palette scans stop after finding the required count.
- **NewChunks** - Queues packet-loaded chunks for checking after they become available to the client.
- **Waypoints** - Discovers coordinates in item NBT from watched held items, opened containers, and nearby dropped items, and reports each position once.
- **NBTEditor** - Added reading of open containers, block entities, and entities. When world editing is enabled, Apply can send `/data merge` commands for blocks and entities.
- **AutoLoot** - Excludes ender chests, can approach eligible dropped items, and throws junk instead of moving it into the loot container. Custom-named items can also count as loot, with shorter action delays and result-check waits.
- **VaultRoll** - Tracks vaults from chunk and block update packets instead of repeatedly scanning loaded block entities; opening observations and item capture use that index.
- **Panic** - Keeps its original hack-state snapshot, disables hacks enabled during Panic, and restores the saved state when Panic is turned off.
- **Mining** - Added server-time tracking and guards for accelerated block-break packets. SpeedNuker now queues break handling; FastBreak can display a readiness countdown.
- **DuraSwap** - Reports whether a viable sacrificial tool is available and its hotbar slot.
- **AttributeSwap** - Added Smart-mode swapping to Density maces while falling and Lunge spears.
- **TriggerBot** - Added an option to require holding left click before attacking.
- **PacketRate** - Added ViaVersion-aware pacing and auto-tune rate-control modes, with instantaneous and sustained limits and a configurable safety margin.
- **Entity filters** - Added creative-player, interaction-entity, and projectile filters; revised mob disposition and baby filtering. Combat hacks can target redirectable or destructible projectiles.
- **NoClip** - Added destination checks and optional rendering.
- **SpawnerESP, RedstoneESP, and WorkstationESP** - Updated scanning and rendering behavior.

## Server Intel

- **Scanner dashboard** - Reworked the interface with separate command scanning, plugin scanning, scan settings, commands, and results sections. Colors follow the ClickGUI theme.
- **Command discovery** - Uses the server’s command tree before client commands are merged into it. Improved handling of command arguments, aliases, redirects, and permission feedback.
- **Command filters** - Added controls to ignore vanilla commands, exclude Essentials commands, and show all, already-known, or newly discovered commands.
- **Probe reliability** - Added longer response waits, retries, broader probe ordering, and additional prefix probes when suggestion responses reach the server limit. Partial-result warnings and saved diagnostics include timeouts, unanswered prefixes, and prefixes skipped because of scan limits.
- **Blocked suggestions** - Detects unavailable active probing and falls back to available server evidence. Automatic execution is disabled when command probing is suppressed.

releases.notes:
## New Hacks

* **AirMiner** - Mines at normal speed while airborne by briefly claiming grounded movement packets.
* **BoatPhase** - Combines BoatFly movement with client-side vehicle phasing, adaptive movement, air substeps, diving, anti-kick handling, and configurable speed controls.
* **ClutchFall** - Automatically places suitable fall-clutch items before landing, including water buckets, powder snow, slime, cobwebs, hay, honey, beds, and sweet berries.
* **ElytraDive** - Targets nearby players, dives toward them with an elytra, and pulls up near terrain.
* **ElytraWalk** - Maintains the elytra flight pose while moving on the ground, with configurable speed, pitch, spin, bobbing, and automatic elytra handling.
* **Flicker** - Animates skin-part visibility, arm state, cape, hand swapping, and held-item visibility through client-information packets.
* **MicDetect** - Notifies you when Simple Voice Chat receives a player voice packet, including the server-reported voice distance.
* **MobView** - Lets you view the world from the perspective of a selected mob.
* **VaultRoll** - Predicts deterministic trial-vault loot using the world seed and synchronizes predictions with observed openings. Includes ominous/trial modes, prediction ESP, warnings, and middle-click information.
* **VillagerRoll** - Predicts deterministic novice librarian trades using the world seed and synchronizes predictions with observed trades.

## New Commands and Utilities

* Added `.vaultroll` for inspecting and controlling VaultRoll.
* Added `.villageroll` for inspecting and controlling VillagerRoll.
* Added `.signhistory` for viewing recorded sign text and removal history.
* Added `.nbteditor` command integration for opening and controlling the NBT editor.
* Added persistent sign-history storage per server and dimension.
* Added VaultRoll and VillagerRoll prediction models, synchronization logic, seed handling, and automated model tests.

## ClickGUI and Interface

* Added a new Modern ClickGUI layout with:
  * Category navigation.
  * Enabled and favorite-hack panels.
  * Independent settings windows.
  * Modern setting controls.
  * Search overlay and standalone search handling.
  * Persistent window layouts.
  * Improved scrolling, resizing, pinning, minimizing, and recently-disabled hack highlighting.
* Updated classic GUI components to work correctly alongside the Modern layout.
* Improved AltGUI, keybind screens, settings screens, dropdowns, sliders, color controls, and list editors.
* Added a PacketFirewall allowed-hacks management screen.

## Updated Hacks and Features

* **ServerIntel**
  * Added packet-based command discovery and command-tree inspection.
  * Added plugin scanning using autocomplete, known packs, namespaces, help responses, plugin-list responses, and version responses.
  * Added verbose server metadata reporting.
  * Added saved per-server scan results and configurable vulnerable-plugin highlighting.
* **SignESP**
  * Added sign-history recording for text changes and removals.
  * Added middle-click lookup and previous-text inspection.
  * Improved sign scanning, rendering, and history queue handling.
* **ElytraPitch**
  * Improved flight control and packet handling.
* **QuickShulker**
  * Improved shulker preview screens, editing, and inventory interaction.
* **AutoSteal**
  * Reworked inventory scanning and item-transfer handling.
* **LootSorter**
  * Improved destination rules, item-family matching, stacking, filtering, and command controls.
* **OfflineSettings**
  * Added quick reconnect, automatic logout, reconnect commands, offline-player controls, OP checks, bulk OP actions, command-feedback controls, and reconnect-through-bot support.
* **StaffMonitor**
  * Added vanish-cycle detection, tab-list rotation filtering, known-staff filtering, and configurable player limits.
* **NoFall, AutoDrop, AutoLoot, BedBreakAura, RoofESP, PearlESP, SpearAssist, AimAssist, CommandSpam, Chat Heads, and other hacks**

# Wurst 7.55 CevAPI (MC26.2) v0.59

## New Hacks

### NBTEditor

  * Read, edit, create, and apply item NBT through a dedicated editor screen.
  * Includes syntax-aware editing, validation, formatting/minification, preset management, and built-in presets.
  * Includes built-in preset library with Big Slime Spawner, Book Spawner, Silverfish Infestation, OP Kit, and Infinite Invincible / Wide Range spawners for charged creepers, hyper ghasts, wardens, withers, and TNT.

### ElytraBounce

  * Automates the timed jump/fall-flying sequence used for fast elytra highway travel, with pitch, sprint, auto-run, chunk-stop, timeout, correction, and speed-cap controls.

### ElytraPitch

  * Provides configurable elytra pitch control for more precise flight movement resulting in a permanent glide without the need for rockets.

### SpawnerESP

  * Highlights ordinary mob spawners with ESP boxes or tracers.
  * Shows the mob type and live distance, with configurable style, color, range, and label scale.

### StairMaker

  * Builds a continuous diagonal staircase in front of you while you walk forward.
  * Supports smooth climbing and can temporarily enable FastPlace while active.

### AntiGeyser

  * Cancels the upward relative motion sent to the local player by Potent Sulfur geysers.
  * Detects Potent Sulfur up to six blocks below the player and optionally hides the geyser particles.

### Creative/OP hacks

  * Added a dedicated Creative/OP category for modules that send commands or use creative/operator-only mechanics.
  * Includes Airstrike+, ArmorStandImages, AutoCommand, AutoDisplays, AutoNames, AutoScoreboard, AutoTexts, AutoTitles, Boom+, ExplosionAura, ForceOPBook, ForceOPSign, ForceTP, HandOfGod, MultiverseAnnihilator, OPServerKillModule, OPplayerTPmodule, UUIDBan, and Voider+. Credits to [Trouser-Streak](https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/wiki/TrouserOP-Creative-Modules).

### SoundMute

  * Selectively mute any Minecraft sound
  
### Global Player/Bot Ignore

  * Added a configurable global ignore list for player and bot names, useful for excluding anticheat bots.
  * PlayerESP, HealthTags, StaffMonitor, Antisocial, and player-range alerts now honor this list.  


## Updated Hacks and Features

### SignESP

  * Added an optional Text overlay that renders a sign’s readable front or back text as a world-space label.
  * Added configurable overlay scale; labels appear from five blocks away and remain readable at longer distances.

### Alt Manager

  * Toggle to remember last connected alt and reconnect to it automatically.
  
### Mention

  * Toggle for partial name flagging.
  
### NoPlayerChat

  * Toggle to allow exception for friend chats in-game.

### QuickShulker

  * Added a full shulker inventory screen and improved shulker interaction handling (Open shulker inventory from within inventory).
  * The optional Shulker Inventory setting opens a client-side preview from a middle-click and applies edits when the screen closes.

### AutoBuild and Custom Build Mode

  * Added a custom-build mode with a graphical profile editor and a Windows launcher (`scripts/custom_build_gui.bat`).
  * Profiles can include or exclude individual hacks, commands, other features, and Wurst Options settings.
  * Added optional imports for a custom mod icon, menu logo, title shader, and first-run defaults (`settings.json`, `enabled-hacks.json`, and `keybinds.json`).
  * Custom builds use `Wurst7-CevAPI-<suffix>` branding while keeping the normal Fabric ID and `.minecraft/wurst` configuration folder.
  * Added automatic filtering of excluded entries and hiding of empty ClickGUI/AltGUI categories; shared mixin infrastructure remains compiled when required.
  * Improved AutoBuild template selection and command handling.
  * Fixed custom-build and template-search issues.

### LootSorter

  * Expanded item-family and destination-rule support.
  * Improved sorting, stacking, item filtering, and command controls.

### AutoFly

releases.notes:
# Release Notes 

## New Hacks

**Untouchable**
- Auto-dodges combat threats by teleporting to nearby safe positions
- Reacts to mace swings, sword/axe users, spear throws, hostile mobs, arrows, and charging creepers
- Dodge types individually toggleable: maces, swords, axes, spears, hostile mobs, arrows, creepers
- `Only primed spears` - only reacts when a spear is actually ready to land
- `Keep distance` - stays at a minimum distance from nearby players, even without an attack
- `Auto distance on damage` / `Auto distance on totem pop` - auto-creates space after taking a hit or popping
- `Keep distance mode` - Always, or only while actively dodging
- `Move pause mode` - suppresses dodging when you're deliberately moving toward target
- `Avoid drops` - won't teleport you off ledges
- Sliders: player distance (3–16), detection range (6–32), reach allowance (3–10), prediction (1–10 ticks), teleport distance (1–12), vertical scan (0–8), teleport packets (1–10), teleport cooldown (1–10 ticks)

**DamageESP**
- Floating damage numbers above players and mobs
- `Players only` toggle - show players only, or players + mobs
- Sliders: text size (0.25–3.0), fade time (6–80 ticks), opacity (10–100%)
- Custom text color

**EntityCount**
- Per-chunk entity counter with on-screen labels
- `POV` mode counts chunks in front of you; `360°` counts all around
- Chunk range slider (1–64, shown as `NxN` chunk grid)
- `Only above threshold` - hides labels below a configurable count
- `Hide zero`, `Highlight highest`, `Show lazy chunks`

**UseItemSpam**
- Repeatedly uses your selected item
- Togglable per item type: crossbow, bow, throwables, consumables, utility items, or all
- Delay slider (0–20 ticks)
- `Correct sequence` - uses current prediction sequence for anti-cheat compatibility
- `Require right click` - only spams while holding use

**RemoteEnderChest**
- Opens your ender chest anywhere, no physical chest needed
- Configurable toggle key (default: left alt)
- `Swap inventory key` - pressing E opens the linked ender chest instead of inventory

**PearlDrop**
- Automated ender pearl dropping into bubble columns or honey blocks for stasis chambers
- Simulates pearl trajectories to find valid landing positions
- Supports both bubble column and honey block setups

**ProjectileESP**
- Dedicated ESP for projectiles (arrows, tridents, snowballs, eggs, pearls, etc.)
- `Include arrows` toggle - turn off to declutter and only show thrown items
- Shows ownership of projectiles
- Color modes: Fixed, Rainbow, By owner (you/player/mob), By type
- Box size: Accurate or Fancy mode

**BlockOverlay** (replaces the old Overlay hack)
- Selection Overlay - customizes the block outline when looking at a block
- Break Progress Overlay - customizes the mining progress animation
- Independent settings for each mode
- Selection color picker with HSV support
- Break start color → end color transition with solid-color override
- Fill toggle - wireframe-only or filled box per mode
- Opacity slider per mode (5%–100%)
- Rainbow mode with speed control (0.01×–2×) per mode
- Pulse mode with speed control (0.01×–10×) per mode
- Glow mode - 4-layer concentric pulsating shells + shimmer effects + corner rays, with intensity slider
- Through-walls toggle per mode
- Selection overlay uses the block's actual hit shape (slabs, stairs, fences, etc.)
- Replaces vanilla's dark-grey selection box when enabled

## Modified Hacks

**AutoChat**
- Now an AI-driven subsystem with OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Ollama support
- Prompt editor GUI for editing prompts in-game
- Prompt manager - maintains prompt state across sessions
- Model override manager - select/override the AI model from ClickGUI or Navigator
- Default preset updated for the new behavior

**PacketTools (AdvancedPacketTool)**
- Expanded into a full packet inspection suite with logging, denial, and delay modes
- Packet dumping with filtering by direction and type
- Decode-coverage tracking - shows which packet types have been seen

- Added Chest Search:
  - Automatically or manually scan each chest you open and store its contents in a JSON file per server
  - Able to detect chest changes that you make, so adding or removing items instantly updates the JSON
  - Unable to detect chest changes that other players make

  - Chests are auto-removed if it has been detected as broken/missing
  - Adjustable Waypoint and ESP timeout
  - Adjustable ESP and Waypoint colors
